data.name: Tasty In Another World
data.detailed_description:
A World Without Flavor

You loved good food.

Unfortunately, a distracted goddess accidentally ended your life while watching cat videos from Earth.

Unable to undo her mistake, the gods offer you a second chance in another world. It sounds like a dream come true—until you discover the world is plagued by monsters, threatened by the Demon King, and worst of all...

The food is terrible.

Monsters roam the land, trade has collapsed, and the livestock have had the flavor scared out of them. Entire villages have forgotten what good food tastes like.

As compensation, the gods allow you to choose a divine blessing. They offer legendary weapons, powerful magic, and priceless artifacts.

Irritated that a distracted goddess caused your untimely death, you choose her instead.

The other gods consider this fitting punishment and immediately send both of you to the new world.

Now magically bound to accompany you until the Demon King is defeated, she has no choice but to help you survive... and revive you whenever you die.

Hunt by Day

Explore a colorful fantasy world filled with monsters, dungeons, and hidden treasures.

Take on guild requests, battle dangerous creatures, gather rare ingredients, and discover the unique flavors hidden within the monsters that roam the land.

While ordinary food has lost its taste, monster ingredients possess incredible culinary potential.

Serve by Night

After a day of adventuring, return to the village restaurant.

From 4 PM to 6 PM, villagers gather for their evening meal. While the dwarf chef prepares delicious monster-based dishes, you and your unwilling goddess companion serve customers, deliver meals, manage orders, and help keep the restaurant running.

Earn money, unlock new recipes, improve the restaurant, and bring life back to struggling community through great food.

Restore Flavor to the World

As your restaurant grows, more travelers visit the village, new ingredients become available, and the people slowly regain hope.

But the source of the world's problems still lies deep within the Demon King's dungeon.

If you want to bring flavor back to the world for good, you'll need to venture deeper, defeat powerful monsters, and uncover the secrets behind the corruption spreading across the land.

Features

  • Fast-paced top-down monster hunting and exploration

  • Gather ingredients from monsters and bosses

  • Run a fantasy restaurant alongside a dwarf chef and reluctant goddess

  • Serve customers during the evening dinner rush

  • Unlock recipes, ingredients, and restaurant upgrades

  • Complete guild quests and explore dangerous dungeons

  • Build relationships with villagers and travelers

  • Die repeatedly and let your frustrated goddess revive you

  • Save a world that has forgotten what good food tastes like

data.short_description: Hunt monsters, gather rare ingredients, and help run a fantasy restaurant in a world where all food has lost its flavor. Serve villagers alongside a reluctant goddess, discover delicious monster cuisine, and restore taste to the world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 or equivalent
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Specifications may change during development.
